## task-001 — activePlan registry
- Added `const activePlan = new Map()` in apis/projects/index.js alongside activeWork; exposed via deps and added to shutdown kill loop (iterates entries `{ child, command }`, kills entry.child).
- Registered/deregistered the child at all 5 plan-family spawns: plan.js revise (plan-revise), generate/Pass A (plan), answers/Pass B (plan), extend (plan-extend); approve.js (approve). Pattern: `activePlan.set(project.id, { child, command })` then `child.on('close', () => activePlan.delete(project.id))`.
- GOTCHA: test/project-drafts-api.test.js builds a mock `deps` for plan/approve routers WITHOUT activePlan; its mock spawnForProject returns `{ on(){} }`. Adding activePlan.set() made the plan/answers/approve endpoints throw 500. Fix: added `activePlan: new Map()` to that mock deps. Any future dep added to these routers must also be added to this test mock.
- Validation: `npm test` (had to `npm install js-yaml` locally — pre-existing missing install; reverted the package.json/lock version bump so it stays out of the commit). All suites pass.
- task-002 will change the subscribe snapshot `process` field (currently `running ? { command: 'work' } : null` at index.js ~line 235) to also report activePlan.

## task-002 — snapshot reporting (process + pending-questions)
- apis/projects/index.js subscribe handler: replaced `process: running ? {command:'work'} : null` with precedence chain — work wins, else `activePlan.get(project_id)` → `{ command: entry.command }` (kind stored in task-001: plan/plan-revise/plan-extend/approve), else null.
- Added `plan_questions_pending` (bool) + `plan_questions_session_id` to snapshot, derived from `fs.existsSync(lib.questionsFileFor(project.path, sid))` using the already-resolved active draft `sid` (line ~214). Wrapped in try/catch → false. Field is false (not null) when no questions pending.
- No client changes (deferred to task-003). project-drafts-api and full suite pass; node --check clean.
- task-003 (client) will read snapshot.process.command + plan_questions_pending to restore generating/revising/approving spinner and gate the questions dialog.

## task-003 — client state restoration (spinner + log on refresh)
- process.js: command kind already flows through setRunning({command,...}) untouched. Added PLAN_COMMANDS=[plan,plan-revise,plan-extend,approve] + planCommand/isPlanRunning computed getters (exported). No change to setRunning/setExited needed — snapshot.process={command} and process.started both carry the same kind.
- ws.js subscribed handler: setRunning(snapshot.process) already forwards the full descriptor incl. command. Added ws-store field `planQuestions` = {projectId, pending, sessionId} set from snapshot.plan_questions_pending (guarded by `'plan_questions_pending' in snapshot`), exported for task-004 to sequence the dialog. Did NOT add `else proc.setExited()` on empty snapshot — the process store is a GLOBAL singleton (not keyed by project), so clearing on an idle project's subscribe could wipe another project's spinner. Fresh refresh inits running=null anyway, so clearing is unnecessary for restore.
- PlanView.vue: imported useProcessStore. Added restorePlanProcessState(info) mapping command→flag (plan/plan-extend→generating, plan-revise→revising, approve→approving). Wired via `watch(() => proc.running, restorePlanProcessState, {immediate:true})` inside onMounted — immediate handles snapshot-already-present, watcher handles snapshot arriving after mount (subscribe is async over socket). Watcher no-ops on null so it never fights the existing process.exited handler that clears flags.
- Log region needs NO template change: existing `v-if="generating||revising||approving"` re-renders the genLogRef terminal automatically once a flag is restored; process.log lines append (Out-of-Scope: tail resumes from reconnect, empty until new lines).
- GOTCHA: plan.questions handler sets generating=false while proc.running stays {command:'plan'} (same ref) — watcher fires only on ref change so it won't resurrect the spinner. Good.
- Validation: npm run check:quick (28/28 incl. Vite build → Vue compiles) + project-drafts-api.test.js (7/7).

## task-004 — questions-dialog sequencing on refresh
- PlanView.vue: added `questionsReady` ref (refresh-only) that renders a "Plan questions ready — answer them to continue generating" continuation in the progress-log region (green pi-check-circle, no spinner, terminal hidden since genLog is empty on refresh) so the QA dialog never appears cold.
- Extracted `applyPlanQuestions(goal_analysis, questions)` shared by the live `plan.questions` socket handler AND the new `restorePlanQuestions()`. Live handler is behaviorally identical (still sets generating=false after; questionsReady stays false so the already-visible spinner hands off).
- `restorePlanQuestions()`: reads ws-store `planQuestions` {projectId,pending,sessionId} (task-003), guards project match + pending + not-already-showing, GETs /plan/questions (passes `?session=` when sessionId known — requestedSession reads query.session/sessionId), only proceeds if data.exists && questions.length, sets questionsReady BEFORE applyPlanQuestions. try/catch swallows → stays on idle view rather than bare dialog.
- Wired via `watch(() => ws.planQuestions, restorePlanQuestions, {immediate:true})` in onMounted, mirroring task-003's proc.running watcher (handles snapshot-before-or-after-mount).
- GOTCHA: `isIdle` gates the whole split layout (`plans.length===0 && !generating && !showNewPlanForm`). A pending-questions draft has NO plan.md yet → plans is empty → isIdle would hide the split layout & progress-log region, so the dialog would float over the idle form. Fixed by adding `!questionsReady.value` to isIdle so the split layout (and the continuation context) renders.
- Cleared questionsReady in submitAnswers (Pass B starts → generating takes over) and cancelQuestions.
- Validation: npm run check:quick (28/28, Vite build compiles Vue) + node test/project-drafts-api.test.js (7/7).

## task-005 — verification + scenario-2 refresh fix
- FULL SUITE GREEN: `npm test` → 54/54 pass, 0 fail (all 8 suites incl. draft-placement.test.js and project-drafts-api.test.js). `npm run check:quick` → 28/28 incl. Vite prod build (Vue compiles).
- DEFECT FOUND & FIXED (scenario 2, the feature's headline case). The subscribe snapshot in apis/projects/index.js derived the pending-questions signal from `resolveActiveDraft()`, which is plan.md-gated (getAllDrafts skips any draft with no plan.md). A mid Pass-A draft has plan-questions.json but NO plan.md yet, so resolveActiveDraft returned null → `plan_questions_pending=false` exactly when questions were pending → on refresh the client never restored the questions dialog (no bare dialog, but also no dialog at all). Reproduced with a tmp project: resolveActiveDraft=null while resolveActiveQuestionDraft finds the draft.
  FIX (in-scope per task-005 "fix the regression within the feature's touched files"; index.js was touched by task-002): resolve the pending signal via `lib.resolveActiveQuestionDraft(project.path) || sid` — the SAME resolver GET /plan/questions already uses — and carry that session id in `plan_questions_session_id`. `plan_session_id`/plan content still use resolveActiveDraft (correct: a questions-only draft has no plan to show).
  REGRESSION TESTS added to project-drafts-api.test.js (snapshotPendingQuestions mirrors the index.js logic): (a) mid Pass-A draft (no plan.md) → pending=true + correct session id, and asserts resolveActiveDraft returns null so a revert re-breaks the test; (b) answered/plain draft (questions file gone) → pending=false.
- SIX SCENARIOS verified by tracing server kind → snapshot → client flag → spinner label:
  1. Generate/Pass A in flight → activePlan {command:'plan'} → generating → "Generating plan..." ✓
  2. Pass A produced questions → Pass A process EXITED (headless returns after emitting plan_questions), so process=null; questions file on disk → plan_questions_pending=true (after fix) → client questionsReady continuation ("Plan questions ready — answer them to continue generating") THEN the QA dialog via applyPlanQuestions → never bare ✓
  3. Answers/Pass B in flight → {command:'plan'} → generating; CLI clears questions file early (bin/jonggrang.js:1616) so no stray dialog ✓
  4. Revise in flight → {command:'plan-revise'} → revising → "Revising plan with AI..." ✓
  5. Approve & Decompose in flight → {command:'approve'} → approving → "Decomposing plan into tasks..." ✓
  6. Extend in flight → {command:'plan-extend'} → generating → "Generating plan..." ✓
  Spinner clears on exit: PlanView `process.exited` handler (line ~1006) sets generating/revising/approving=false; restored spinners reuse those same flags, so the live exit event clears them.
- NO WORK-MODE REGRESSION: process precedence keeps `work` winning and still emits {command:'work'} exactly as before; activeWork/orchestration untouched; restorePlanProcessState maps only plan-family commands so 'work' never touches plan flags. planQuestions ws field is additive.
- NOTE (out of scope, negligible): a sub-second window exists where a plan process is still running AND the questions file is briefly present (between the agent's `plan ask` write and Pass A return, or Pass B start and its early clear). A refresh in that window could show the generating spinner AND the questions continuation together — still a visible generating context, so it satisfies the "never a bare dialog" criterion. Not worth guarding.
- Files touched: test/project-drafts-api.test.js, apis/projects/index.js.
